body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
`temporal-sql-tool` supports reading the SQL database password from the environment or as a command line argument. Both of these result in the password being readable from the process table (`/proc`). For defense in depth, it would be preferable to read the password from a file.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Support reading the SQL database password from a file by setting an option like `--password-file` or an `SQL_PASSWORD_FILE` environment variable.

comments.body: I would like to contribute to this issue

You may be able to work around by using `.pgpass` file like what @taraspos mentioned here: https://github.com/temporalio/helm-charts/issues/321#issuecomment-4303366607. 

It does sounds like a good addition nonetheless as more explicit solution, which would also work for MySQL. @saad1998 we will accept a contribution, add it to this issue once you have it.
Confirmed that a `PGPASSFILE` of `/home/temporal/.pgpass` works for `temporal-sql-tool`.

title: Support reading SQL password from file in temporal-sql-tool
